subject.title: fix(agents): add tool-use terminal continuation for codex app-server toolUse stops

question: Which owner-enforced mechanism should make the post-tool continuation unable to execute tools while preserving the existing Codex native thread?
rationale: Prompt wording cannot guarantee that a model will not repeat side effects, and the documented Codex boundary does not expose transcript mutation as a safe substitute.

options.title: Codex-owned tool-free continuation
options.body: Add a Codex harness or native-hook continuation mode that preserves the thread while denying every tool during the single synthesis turn.

options.title: Generic runner policy override
options.body: Extend the embedded attempt loop with an explicit one-turn empty tool policy, but prove the override is correct for every provider admitted by the retry guard.

options.title: Pause pending upstream support
options.body: Do not add continuation until Codex exposes a stable continuation or per-turn tool-disable contract that OpenClaw can enforce.

recommendation.title: Codex-owned tool-free continuation
recommendation.body: Add a Codex harness or native-hook continuation mode that preserves the thread while denying every tool during the single synthesis turn.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent safety-path landing and Codex runtime ownership make this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
